core_material_sources.supported_material_description: ALG-Ph and HA-Ph ink solutions precede the separately described photoprinting procedure. Apparent-viscosity measurement and oscillatory-modulus measurement are described separately. Calling the analysed records precursor-ink flow curves is compatible with these passages.
condition_limits: The 22.5 C statement is attached to oscillatory-modulus measurements; a flow-temperature assignment is not established.
The publication instrument scan range is not a substitute for the admitted cache support.
Per-record batch identities, replicate independence, complete flow history and measurement-state linkage are not established by these passages.
The source study is acellular; no cell-containing or post-crosslinked-gel validation claim should be added.
